metadata.title: A Candle lamp
metadata.introduction: The form of the candle lamp is exquisite, presenting a blend of simplicity and fashion. Constructed from mild steel sheet, this product boasts durability and easy maintenance. Its operational mechanism involves utilizing a light bulb for heating, which effectively accelerate the candle's surface. The switch is a knot design ,by rotating, the temperature and brightness of the light can be adjusted to the desired levels.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.text:
The product before teardown
From its initial look, it can mainly separate into four parts. The top ( lamp shade) , the stand ( the tube ) , the base and the wire & controller.
Overall product dimension : 290 x 185x 150mm . Weight : 585 gram

steps.title: Step 2
steps.text:
The back of the lamp base was pulled off and flipped over revealing the base structure. Here a craft knife was used for the removal.
The cap functions as a cover to hide the cable , its material is High-density Polyethylene ( HDPE) and is injection molded.
The dimension is 15cm diameter x5mm thickness , its weight is 29g.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.text:
The white lock to secure the wire and it was removed by a grip and a wire cutter
The lamp base is a platform for a candle to sit on top, this view is a close up to see where does the cable goes
The lamp base is made of mild steel and it’s about 15cm diameter x2.7cm height with 142grams in weight.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.text:
The hex nut was removed by the spanner.
The number 6 spanner was used

steps.title: Step 5
steps.text:
Remove the screws inside the light bulb connector
The screws are machined made and the type of screws is a mushroom-head with 4mm head diameter 10mm tall.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.text:
Cut the connector head and pull out the cable after removing the nut from both sides
The image showed a light bulb connector and its probably a HDPE or Acrylonitrile Butadiene Styrene (ABS) plastic , injection melded , overall dimension is 28mm diameter x 17mm in height

steps.title: Step 7
steps.text:
Remove the control panel case by unfastening the screw
The case functions to protect damages from the circuit board and it’s made by ABS/ HDPE , injection molded with an overall dimension 900mm length x 400 width x10 height, 21gram in weight

steps.title: Step 8
steps.text:
Pull out the cable from the tube
The cable jacket is PVC , 1230mm length with 6mm thickness , weigh in 78gram

steps.title: Step 9
steps.text: Separate parts : the nuts , the lamp stand, the lamp shade , the base, the controller case , the dimmerable knot and the screws

steps.title: Step 10
steps.text: Here is the small component close-up shot of the diassembly of the candle lamp

steps.title: Step 11
steps.text: Finished the product teardown. There are about 14 components of it.

conclusion: To reassemble your device, follow these instructions in reverse order.
